name: NRG Energy
description: NRG is mainly a retailer of electricity and natural gas that owns the power plants behind part of its supply. It sells power and gas to about 6 million homes plus businesses, data centers and wholesale buyers under brands such as Reliant, NRG, Green Mountain Energy and Direct Energy, and since March 2023 also runs Vivint Smart Home (about 2.4 million smart-home customers). About 96% of 2025 revenue ($29.5B of $30.7B) is retail revenue, and it owned about 12 GW of mostly Texas generation at year-end 2025; on January 30, 2026 it closed the purchase of 13 GW of gas-fired plants and the CPower demand-response platform from LS Power. It does not fit the conventional Independent Power Producer box well: profit comes from the retail margin over supply cost, hedged by owned plants, not from selling plant output to utilities under long-term contracts.

gics.note: Conventional filing label: GICS Sector 'Utilities' and Sub-Industry 'Independent Power Producers & Energy Traders' per Wikipedia 'List of S&P 500 companies' (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_S%26P_500_companies, read 2026-09-30). That list gives only Sector and Sub-Industry. SEC SIC code 4911 (Electric Services) per EDGAR.

employees.note: Includes 7,929 active smart-home direct sales and installation individuals, which are largely seasonal; about 4% of employees under collective bargaining (FY2025 10-K)

businessLines.name: Texas
businessLines.how: Retail customers pay monthly for electricity under fixed-price, variable-price and term contracts; the owned plants supply part of the load so NRG earns the spread between retail price and its supply cost, with the remainder of supply bought or sold in the market.
businessLines.description: Customer, plant and market operations in Texas: retail sales to homes and businesses backed by a fleet of 9,271 MW; the 10-K says Texas generation supply is fully integrated with retail load.

operatingProfit.note: Segment operating income; segment net income $1112M (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1013871/000101387126000004/nrg-20251231.htm)

businessLines.name: East
businessLines.how: Retail and commercial customers pay for electricity and gas under contracts priced off market supply; NRG earns the margin over procurement cost.
businessLines.description: Customer, plant and market operations in the eastern US, retail and business-to-business electricity and gas sales; 2,073 MW of owned generation.

operatingProfit.note: Segment operating income; segment net income $710M (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1013871/000101387126000004/nrg-20251231.htm)

businessLines.name: West/Other
businessLines.how: Retail and wholesale electricity and gas sales and plant output, margin over supply cost.
businessLines.description: Customer, plant and market operations in the West and Canada plus other investments.

operatingProfit.note: Segment operating income; segment net income $120M (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1013871/000101387126000004/nrg-20251231.htm)

businessLines.name: Vivint Smart Home
businessLines.how: Monthly subscription and monitoring fees from households, plus equipment and installation sold through direct sales; high depreciation and amortisation ($810M in 2025) from acquired intangibles and capitalised customer-acquisition costs.
businessLines.description: Smart-home security and automation (Vivint), acquired March 10, 2023: about 2.4 million customers at Dec 31, 2025 (2,226K in 2024).

operatingProfit.note: Segment operating income; segment net income $33M (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1013871/000101387126000004/nrg-20251231.htm)

businessLines.name: Corporate and eliminations
businessLines.how: Not an operating business: corporate costs and parent interest.
businessLines.description: Corporate activities, intersegment eliminations and parent-company interest.

operatingProfit.note: Corporate operating loss; corporate net loss -$1,111M after $741M interest and tax (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1013871/000101387126000004/nrg-20251231.htm)

brands.name: NRG, Reliant, Direct Energy, Green Mountain Energy (retail energy brands named in the 10-K)
brands.note: About 5.6 million home electricity and gas customers at Dec 31, 2025 (5,632K; 5,748K in 2024). The 10-K says its retail brands collectively have the largest share of competitively served residential electric customers in Texas (no percentage given).

brands.name: CPower (demand response) and LSP Portfolio
brands.note: 18 gas-fired and dual-fuel plants totalling about 13 GW across nine states, bought from LS Power under the May 12, 2025 agreement; not in FY2025 figures
